name: Wow! signal
telescope: Big Ear Radio Observatory (Ohio State University)
alphabet: 0-9 then A-Z = 10..35, intensity in units of standard deviation above background
frequency_note: 1420.4556 MHz per Gray & Ellingsen / Kraus reanalysis; Ehman's original note gave 1420.3556 MHz. Both lie inside the protected 1400-1427 MHz radio-astronomy band.
references: J. Ehman, 'The Big Ear Wow! Signal: What We Know and Don't Know About It After 20 Years' (bigear.org/wow20th.htm)
